text: Velveeta is built from milk, whey and milk protein concentrate with emulsifying phosphates and citrates rather than mainly from ripened cheese, which gives its soft, velvety melt. Because milk protein concentrate is not a permitted ingredient under the US process-cheese standards, it is labelled a 'pasteurized prepared cheese product'.
